result.detail: 1) No formal_spec was produced. Section 8 of the interface spec and section 5 of the microarchitecture plan both ask for an unbounded proof at N=8 and N=32. formal.run takes only one .sby, and this task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench, so the proof is left for a follow-on task. A follow-on can cover only one of N=8 or N=32 per task. 2) Lint and synthesis run on apb_gpio.v with its defaults (N=8). The N=32 configuration is elaborated only by the testbench's second instance, so lint at N=32 needs a separate platform run. 3) The address decode assumes ADDR_WIDTH >= 7; only 8 is required by the spec. 4) The testbench drives inputs after the falling edge and samples outputs 1 time unit later. It uses no `timescale (to avoid Verilator TIMESCALEMOD) and needs a Verilator build with --timing/--binary, plus Icarus SV mode for $error. Under Verilator's default error limit, the first $error may end the run before the verdict line prints; either way that run counts as failed. 5) The DATA_IN write gets PSLVERR and changes nothing; unmapped reads return 0 with PSLVERR. prdata is zero during a write access, as the microarchitecture states.
